name: Decrypt Student Worker Data Pipeline
description: This pipeline retrieves an encrypted student worker file from an SFTP server, decrypts it using PGP decryption, and securely uploads the decrypted file back to the SFTP server.

parameters.name: privateKeyDecrypt
parameters.label: PGP Private Key for Decryption
parameters.description: The PGP private key used to decrypt the student worker data file.

parameters.name: passphraseDecrypt
parameters.label: PGP Passphrase
parameters.description: The passphrase associated with the PGP private key used for decryption.

parameters.name: publicKeyVerify
parameters.label: PGP Public Key for Verification
parameters.description: The PGP public key used to verify the digital signature for authenticity confirmation.

parameters.name: privateKeySFTP
parameters.label: SFTP Private Key
parameters.description: The private key used for authenticating with the SFTP server.

parameters.name: sftpUsername
parameters.label: SFTP Username
parameters.description: The username for authenticating with the SFTP server.

parameters.name: sftpHost
parameters.label: SFTP Host
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the SFTP server.

parameters.name: sftpSourceFilePath
parameters.label: SFTP Source File Path
parameters.description: The full file path on the SFTP server where the encrypted file is located.

parameters.name: sftpDestinationFilePath
parameters.label: SFTP Destination File Path
parameters.description: The full file path on the SFTP server where the decrypted file will be uploaded.

pipeline: SFTP Get - Retrieve Encrypted Student Worker File
Decrypt Data - Decrypt Data with PGP
SFTP Put - Upload Decrypted File to SFTP

SFTP Get - Retrieve Encrypted Student Wo.description: Retrieves the encrypted student worker file from the SFTP server using private key authentication.

Decrypt Data - Decrypt Data with PGP.description: Decrypts the file content using PGP decryption with the provided private key and verifies the digital signature using the sender's public key.

SFTP Put - Upload Decrypted File to SFTP.description: Securely uploads the decrypted CSV file to the configured SFTP server using private key authentication.
